title: Serine hydrolases designed from scratch
summary: The April 2025 Science version describes RFdiffusion enzyme backbones and PLACER assessment of catalytic-state ensembles. Laboratory characterization found catalytic efficiency up to 2.2 × 10^5 M^-1 s^-1, crystal structures with C-alpha RMSD below 1 angstrom, and catalysts in five folds different from natural serine hydrolases. This summary follows the abstract and figure descriptions; an earlier bioRxiv version was posted in August 2024.
organization: University of Washington; University of California, Los Angeles; Howard Hughes Medical Institute

evidence.tested: Enzyme activity assays and crystallographic comparison of designed catalysts.
evidence.unknown: Not assessed: complete design success rates and supplementary data.
evidence.ai_role: RFdiffusion generated backbones; PLACER assessed catalytic-state geometry.
